headline: Why Baxter (BAX) Stock Is Up Today
summary: Shares of healthcare company Baxter International (NYSE:BAX) jumped 3.6% in the afternoon session after TD Cowen raised its price target on the stock to $24 from $20. The firm maintained its hold rating on the shares, which suggests the analyst recommends neither buying nor selling the stock at its current price.
